primaryMethod: Paired file:// diagnostic HTML builds, identical embedded assets/CSS and minification, debug API only for fixtures. Actual friend build tested separately offline without the debug API. Chrome headless, AMD Radeon/ANGLE D3D11, 1440x900 DPR1 balanced, no CPU throttling; 15s warmup + 12s sample. No simultaneous benchmarks. Not a campaign or physical device result.

fileBefore.method: Desktop Chrome, 1440x900 DPR1 balanced quality, no throttling. Isolated 20/100 and oversized 25/300 friendly/enemy fixtures. High HP, replenished enemies, zero enemy weapon damage, bile disabled. 15 s warmup followed by 12 s sample; backlog at both sample boundaries is recorded. No campaign, mobile or physical-phone performance claim.

notes: The final build improves the heavy fixture; FPS in the lighter fixture did not improve despite lower measured CPU time. Do not generalize to every scene or device.
Final development heavy runs were 32.12/31.41 FPS. An earlier 37.76 sample preceded the transparency-sorting fix and is not the final-build result.
Performance.now timings include browser/driver waits, not hardware CPU cycle counters. Requested upload bytes are requested active buffer ranges, not a GPU memory bus measurement.
All fixed simulation debt is retained; no clocks, damage, movement or enemy counts are reduced for the result.
